name: We Could Just Be Annoying
source:
Harper and Cherry are obsessed with their idol Harmonious Witch.

Well, Cherry more than Harper, but who cares about that!?

What really matters right this moment is somehow figuring out a way to get Harmonious Witch to actually know they exist, and what better way than demo tapes!? Not like the tapes are amateurish and are going to reveal both how this pair of witches both aren't on the same page in this whole road trip after their idol AND how their idol is doing some... kinda weird stuff as time goes on.

Nothing like that's going to happen, right? Right? Nope, just some music and vibes.

[From [url=https://bibixp.itch.io/we-could-just-be-annoying]itch.io[/url]]
